$comment: The words two products say the SAME fact with — written once (spec/README.md « One fact, one wording »). An entry is a shared sentence: its English text (parameters as {name}), the key the SITE writes it under in website/lang/en.json (null when only the mod says it, and why), and the screen nodes of the mod that carry it. check-spec.py holds them: the site's English value is this text (`:name` read as `{name}`), each node of each screen says exactly this, and no other text of a screen document repeats an entry without being named here. The site's 19 other languages and the mod's own wording are not touched: this is the English source both read. Not in spec/screens/: that folder is the mod's screens, every .json in it is embedded and parsed as one.

edit.question.text: “{words}” is a new form of “{term}”. Apply to:
edit.question.note: The question a correction asks when changed words are no known writing of a term (LineEditing.Question). The mod's bind `question` is this text with the two names written in.

edit.all_texts_help.text: Add the words to the term as a new form, for every text that cites it.
